npc_dat.description: NPC entity DAT (file_id 6720+zone). Read for name/entity resolution; not currently written by event actions.

scene_dat.description: Scene resource DAT that holds this cutscene's camera Routes + EffectRoutines. Required when the cutscene has a camera block; may be shared with existing retail scene resources.

resources.description: Resource files this event action consumes at build time. All paths are relative to projects/resources.

cutscene.description: Path to a cutscene definition (schema: xi.cutscene.v1 — see event_cutscene.json). Compiles to Event DAT bytecode + Dialog DAT strings + scene DAT camera Routes.

cast.description: Path to a cast definition (schema: xi.cutscene.npc.v1 — see cutscene_npc.json). Can be inlined into cutscene instead.

dialog.description: Path to a dialog definition (schema: xi.cutscene.dialog.v1 — see cutscene_dialog.json). Can be inlined into cutscene instead.

dialogue.description: Legacy — plain dialogue-only event (schema-less, matches `xi event dialogue new` inputs). Prefer 'cutscene' for new work.
